_comment: Real end-to-end RAG validation dataset for EKIP.
Every `grounded` question below is answerable ONLY from content actually
ingested into the target organization by the real GitHub and Slack
connectors (plus one human-published knowledge document). The
from that ingested content -- they are not invented, and they are not
paraphrases of what the model 'should probably say'. See README.md for how
each field is used as a pass/fail criterion.
`negative` questions are deliberately NOT answerable from the corpus. Two
of them (k8s-autoscaling, aws-spend) are domain-adjacent and
plausible-sounding on purpose: those are the ones a weak RAG system
confabulates a confident answer for, which is exactly the failure mode

questions.question: Why were users unable to log in through Google Workspace SSO, and what fixed it?
What caused the application containers to restart due to embedding worker memory usage, and what configuration change resolved it?
Why does the incidents API return an HTTP 500 error when filtering by date range?
What happened during the suspicious login attempts incident, and what mitigation was applied?
Why did the Alembic database migration fail with a lock timeout, and what solution was recommended?
What caused the API latency increase after the analytics deployment, and how was it resolved?
What changes were made to improve retrieval accuracy when the RAG system was returning irrelevant documents?
According to the runbook, what should be checked first when checkout returns a 500 error?
Which application version was deployed to production when the API latency problem began?
What is our company's parental leave policy and how many weeks are paid?
questions.why_unanswerable: No HR/benefits content of any kind was ingested into this organization.

questions.question: Who won the 2022 FIFA World Cup final and what was the score?
questions.why_unanswerable: Completely out of domain; answerable only from the LLM's parametric memory, never from retrieved evidence.

questions.question: What are the Kubernetes horizontal pod autoscaler CPU thresholds configured for the checkout service?
questions.why_unanswerable: Domain-adjacent and plausible-sounding, but there is no Kubernetes or autoscaling content in the corpus. A weak RAG system confabulates specific thresholds here.

questions.question: How much did we spend on AWS infrastructure in Q3 2025, and which service cost the most?
questions.why_unanswerable: Domain-adjacent and plausible-sounding, but no billing, cost, or cloud-spend data was ingested. A weak RAG system invents a dollar figure here.
